description: Welcome to Chorus Music v1.2.1! This update focuses on improved lyrics validation and build system enhancements.

changelog.title: Features & Improvements
items: Lyrics Matching: Improved lyrics validation and matching logic to ensure more accurate lyrics display

changelog.title: Bug Fixes
items: Player: Repeat mode is now automatically disabled when playing from a new place (e.g. albums, playlists)
Home Algorithm: Fixed a duplication bug in the home screen recommendation algorithm
